title: Missing Bayesian semantics
input: The only supplied fact is that a coin produced eight heads in ten tosses. No hypothesis set, prior, or likelihood model is specified. Choose the honest status of a requested Bayesian answer.

option_menu.A: The unique Bayesian posterior that the coin is biased is 80%.
option_menu.B: The data prove the coin is biased.
option_menu.C: No unique Bayesian posterior or Bayes factor is defined until hypotheses, priors, and likelihoods are supplied.
